dogecoin.text: @DogeJake0832 @elonmusk Well, maybe I do man. But you knwo what? This is what people think. Ask anyone in the crypto market outside of Twitter and you'll see how "dogecoin is shit", "it only pumped cuz of elon", "elon crashed it". Also, no one actually sees doge as better than other cryptos out there.

@DogeJake0832 @elonmusk Dogecoin was my very first crypto asset ever, I got in initially because of elon as well, but started to like it because it wasn't as "formal" as other crypto communities. But I had no idea it would this dirty and bad. I haven't had the same view on elon since may 8th.

@DogeJake0832 @elonmusk He's not to blame directly, but remember that the crash back in may started after elon said tesla wouldn't accept bitcoin anymore I believe. And even I'd that's not reason enough to blame him, look at how dogecoin only went up because of him, and he called it a hussle.

Even me, someone who loves #dogecoin, can recognise that it wasn't cool. #dogecoin was a meme coin, but it really behaved like any shitcoin out there. An @elonmusk is STILL the one to blame for tons of people who rugged with it.

People like me were lucky and actually made money on #dogecoin but tons of people lost money. Think about it, it went from like 6 cents to 70 cents in a couple weeks and in about 2 or 3 days it collapsed rug pulling basically everyone...

You know why #dogecoin hasn't really moved in a long time? Because a lot of people got burned with it. I know tons of people who go rug pulled with #doge, and unfortunately their opinion on it is still "fuck that shitcoin"...
